text: The group outlined actions to provide recommendations for head office specifications and to delegate a Project Supervisor to oversee tasks.
Evaluation activities were planned, with all team members expected to provide individual ratings and the average rating computed.
Several problems were raised: unclear pricing currency, uncertain profitability due to unaccounted overheads, budget overhead omissions, and unknown costs for voice recognition integration.

Decisions established: use a kinetic charger, place kinetic batteries near the hinge, proceed to prototype and market, rubber counted as one unit cost, interface push-buttons, proposals to remove voice recognition, and adjust pricing to fit.
